questionEn: How to correctly understand the term “body”?
choicesEn: An object that has mass, shape, and size
A collection of particles with chemical properties
choicesUz: Massasi, shakli va o'lchamiga ega bo'lgan ob'ekt
Kimyoviy xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan zarralar to'plami
explanationEn: A body is an object with mass, shape and size.
explanationUz: Tana - bu massasi, shakli va hajmi bo'lgan ob'ekt.
